text: The platform is technically correct and fast. This lesson is the skill that's easy to skip: sitting with the first real week of live data and reading what it's actually saying -- not just confirming it loaded.

Two things stand out. Store 06 is running about eighteen percent below the fourteen-store average for the week. And Outdoor Cooking is the fastest-growing category, consistently, across nearly every store.

Those two findings don't get the same confidence. One store's one week is weak evidence -- it could be a closed road or a staffing gap. A pattern repeating independently across thirteen locations is much stronger.

The responsible move is attaching a confidence level to each finding out loud, not presenting every number in the same confident tone just because the dashboard renders them all in the same clean font.
A specific follow-up date gets set for Store 06, not a vague promise to keep an eye on it. Four weeks later, that number hasn't gone away -- it's gotten more specific.
